title.zh: 全流程地图：先定位，再学单步
title.en: Full-process map: locate the step, then learn it

subtitle.zh: 从裸晶圆、器件形成到互连、WAT和封装测试
subtitle.en: From bare wafers and device formation to interconnects, WAT, packaging and test

body.zh: 衬底准备；SiO₂；Si；裸晶圆清洗、氧化/氮化、；薄膜沉积、退火、CMP
body.en: Substrate preparation SiO₂ Si Bare-wafer cleaning, oxidation/nitridation, thin-film deposition, annealing and CMP

body.zh: FEOL器件形成；栅极；侧墙；源/漏；阱形成、栅极、LDD/extension、；掺杂（源/漏）、退火、硅化、；接触孔
body.en: FEOL device formation Gate Spacer Source / drain Well formation, gate, LDD/extension, source/drain doping, annealing, silicidation, and contacts

body.zh: MOL接触结构；介质层；接触孔；硅化层；介质沉积、平坦化、；接触孔光刻/刻蚀、清洗、；金属阻挡/内衬、填充
body.en: MOL contact structures Dielectric Contact hole Silicide Dielectric deposition, planarization, contact lithography/etch, cleaning, metal barrier/liner and fill

body.zh: BEOL金属互连；金属层；［原图标签无法可靠辨认］；通孔；接触孔；多层介质/平坦化、通孔、；金属阻挡/种子、金属填充、；CMP
body.en: BEOL metal interconnects Metal layer [Source label unclear] Via Contact hole Multilayer dielectric/planarization, vias, metal barrier/seed, metal fill, and CMP

body.zh: Passivation与WAT；钝化层；开窗；焊盘；钝化层沉积、开窗、金属垫层、；钝化平坦化；WAT电性测试；（晶圆级）
body.en: Passivation and WAT Passivation layer Opening Bond pad Passivation deposition, openings, metal pads, passivation planarization; WAT electrical tests (wafer level)

body.zh: 6；切割、封装与测试；晶圆切割；芯片分选；封装组装；晶圆切割、芯片分选、封装（键合/模塑/引线框/基板等）、；成品电性测试与老化；成品测试
body.en: 6 Dicing, packaging and test Wafer dicing Die sorting Package assembly Wafer dicing, die sorting, packaging (bonding/molding/leadframes/substrates, etc.), finished-device electrical testing and burn-in Finished-device testing

body.zh: 清洗、光刻、沉积、刻蚀、掺杂、热处理与CMP会在不同膜层反复循环
body.en: Cleaning, lithography, deposition, etching, doping, heat treatment and CMP recur across film levels

body.zh: 四个整合控制；热预算；层间对准；污染控制；表面地形
body.en: Four integration controls Thermal budget Interlayer alignment Contamination control Surface topography

body.zh: 耦合与风险；前层CD/膜厚/应力/表面状态；改变下一步窗口；层间错位；接触开路；金属短路；热预算超标
body.en: Coupling and risks Previous-layer CD/thickness/stress/surface condition changes the next-step window Layer misalignment Open contact Metal short Thermal-budget exceedance

body.zh: 流程边界；这是一套学习框架；；FEOL/MOL/BEOL定；义和实际路线会随器；件、节点、材料与Fab；政策变化。
body.en: Flow boundaries This is a learning framework; definitions of FEOL/MOL/BEOL and actual routes vary with device, node, material and fab policy

body.zh: 量测反馈：Inline CD / 膜厚 / Overlay / Defect / WAT；CD-SEM；膜厚（椭圆偏振仪）；Overlay（对准）；Defect（缺陷检测）；WAT（电性参数）
body.en: Metrology feedback: inline CD / thickness / overlay / defect / WAT CD-SEM Film thickness (ellipsometry) Overlay (alignment) Defect inspection WAT (electrical parameters)

body.zh: 厚；I (A)；10⁻³；10⁻⁶；10⁻⁹；10⁻¹²；CD；V (V)；薄；目标层 — 实际层；缺陷；Id-Vg / 测试分布
body.en: Thick I (A) 10⁻³ 10⁻⁶ 10⁻⁹ 10⁻¹² CD V (V) Thin Target layer — actual layer Defect Id–Vg / test distribution

body.zh: 影响：器件性能 / 互连RC /良率 /可靠性
body.en: Impact: device performance / interconnect RC / yield / reliability

notes.zh: BEOL图第二条材料标签原图字形异常，无法可靠辨认；未根据工艺常识替换，请对照原图。
notes.en: The second BEOL material label is malformed and cannot be read reliably. It has not been replaced using process assumptions; consult the original.
